subcategories.definition: Stuffed, plush and soft knitted toys including teddies, soft dolls, soft animals and character plush.
subcategories.boundary: Includes items described as soft toy, teddy, plush/knitted doll or soft animal. Excludes feltcraft doll kits (sewing_craft), doorstops shaped like dolls/animals, money boxes, and decorative wall plaques such as flying ducks.

subcategories.definition: Tabletop board games, card games, matching/top trumps games, bingo, dominoes, jigsaws and puzzle blocks.
subcategories.boundary: Includes classic and licensed card/board games and jigsaw puzzles. Excludes outdoor/garden skittles, croquet, flying discs, traditional action toys and construction/play figure sets.

subcategories.definition: Ceramic, wooden or novel money boxes, piggy banks and coin banks used for saving money.
subcategories.boundary: Includes items described as money box, money bank, piggy bank or coin bank. Excludes tins that are for storage even if stacking/nesting (kitchen_storage).

subcategories.definition: Toys designed for outdoor or physical active play, including garden games, windmills, flying toys, skittles, skipping ropes, catch cups, spinning tops and similar.
subcategories.boundary: Includes garden croquet, skittles, flying discs, gliders, toy helicopters, windmills, inflatable globes/balls, skipping ropes and traditional action toys. Excludes tabletop board/card games and jigsaw puzzles.

subcategories.definition: Fabric or collapsible storage bags/bins designed to tidy away toys.
subcategories.boundary: Includes items described as toy tidy. Excludes decorative baskets, kitchen tins and general household storage.

subcategories.definition: Small play figures, dollhouse room sets and pretend-play tool sets, including single figurines and multi-piece sets.
subcategories.boundary: Includes multi-piece animal/dinosaur/creepy crawly sets, dollhouse furniture rooms, and child's role-play tool sets. Excludes soft toys, board/card games, puzzles and outdoor toys.

proposal.comment: Split by product function into soft toys, games/puzzles, money boxes, outdoor/active toys, toy storage and playsets/figurines. Items that were clearly not toys (e.g. stationery, sewing kit, household textiles, cards, jewellery, kitchen tins) were reassigned to existing categories.
